title_zh: 都江堰：两千年不衰的水利工程
title_en: Chinese History (19/20): Dujiangyan, a Waterworks That Has Lasted Two Thousand Years
note_en: 既…又… links two qualities or abilities that something has at once: 既能防洪，又能灌溉农田 "it can both prevent floods and irrigate farmland." English says "both A and B" with one verb, but Chinese repeats the helping verb 能 in each half. The pattern is a natural fit for describing anything that does two jobs, like this waterworks.
